The Approach

A systems-thinking executive

I don't just support leadership.
I strengthen the systems leadership depends on.

Most organizations don't fail on vision. They fail in the gap between what leadership intends and what teams actually execute. That gap is where I work.

Across enterprise operations, human capital, workplace experience, and executive partnership, I build scalable operating models, strengthen cross-functional partnerships, and create governance structures that make performance predictable — not personality-dependent.

The result is an organization that runs with greater clarity, consistency, and accountability: engagement that rises and holds, financial controls that protect trust, programs that outlast their founder, and leaders who are heard the way they intend to be.

2020

Enterprise Ownership & Cultural Infrastructure

Built the foundations others would stand on.
